description: The file defines the Incrementor class, a utility for managing a counter with an upper limit, which throws an exception or triggers a callback upon reaching the maximum count.

classes.name: Incrementor
classes.description: A utility class for incrementing a counter until a specified maximum, with customizable behavior upon reaching the maximum.

classes.name: Incrementor.MaxCountExceededCallback
classes.description: An interface for defining a callback action to be triggered when the maximum count is exceeded.

methods.name: Incrementor()
methods.description: Default constructor. Requires setting maximum count later.

methods.name: Incrementor(int max)
methods.description: Constructor setting maximum count with default callback that throws an exception.

methods.name: Incrementor(int max, MaxCountExceededCallback cb)
methods.description: Constructor setting maximum count and a custom callback to invoke upon count exceeding the maximum.

methods.name: setMaximalCount(int max)
methods.description: Sets the maximum count for the counter.

methods.name: canIncrement()
methods.description: Checks if incrementing is allowed without exceeding the maximum.

methods.name: incrementCount(int value)
methods.description: Increments the counter by a specified value.

methods.name: incrementCount()
methods.description: Increments the counter by one, triggering callback if maximum is exceeded.
